name: stale-cache
title: Stale prices after update (multi-file)
prompt:
Bug report from the shop team: "After `update_price`, `get_product` sometimes still returns the OLD
price — especially when the code is typed differently, like `' ab-1 '` vs `'AB-1'`. We also see the
same product twice in `list_products`."

Product codes are case-insensitive and surrounding spaces do not matter. Codes are stored and returned
trimmed and upper-case. Adding a product with an existing code replaces it. `update_price` on an
unknown code raises `KeyError`. Fix the `shop` package (look at all its modules).
